category_title: Students overwhelmed by rote volume who require hands-on instructional methods
scenario_title: High-volume rote math homework in first grade
minimal_context: Zachary is sitting with his tutor to complete a daily first-grade math homework page containing thirty problems.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's open your math book for tonight. You need to complete this page of thirty problems.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That's thirty problems on one page. I can't do a whole page a day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just start with the first one and keep going.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's too many. My brain functions differently than a lot of other children.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You are not really trying to do your math right now. You just need to finish the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts to cry) I am just so overwhelmed with that!
